'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament John Veasey LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This]]
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
